verdict.rationale: Retell's own docs say a single- or multi-prompt agent can connect to a remote MCP server and call that server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation, which is the core of this story. The evidence documents this only for remote servers and only for single/multi-prompt agents, with no detail on configuration, auth or transport, tool selection, or other agent types such as node-based flows. Retell's own MCP server (used from Cursor or Claude) is the server role and is not credited here. missing for 10: documented support beyond remote servers and single/multi-prompt agents, configuration/auth/tool-filtering details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect your single- or multi-prompt agent to a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and the agent can call that server's tools during a live call.
Connect a Retell single- or multi-prompt agent to a remote MCP server so it can call the server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation.
